integrity: Complete deterministic face enumeration, globally checked acyclic discrete-Morse matching, signed integer Morse boundary, unit minor and independent mod-two ranks are reproducible in the accompanying artifacts.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the ordinary matching complex of P4 Cartesian C4 only. The motivating 2026 preprint full text was unavailable, and no claim of absolute literature novelty or independent mathematical certification is made.
title: Integral homotopy of the four-by-four square cylinder matching complex
